title: Endangering the Welfare of a Child
grade_or_penalty: Sexual conduct or abuse/neglect by someone with a legal duty or caretaker responsibility: 2nd degree; by others: 3rd degree. Child sexual abuse material: 1st to 4th degree based on conduct and quantity
key_points: Engaging in sexual conduct that would impair or debauch a child's morals, or causing harm that would make a child abused or neglected.
Producing, distributing or possessing child sexual abuse material.
elements: (a)(2): The suspect caused the child harm that would make the child an abused or neglected child, OR (a)(1) engaged in sexual conduct that would impair or debauch the child's morals
Note whether the suspect had a legal duty of care or assumed responsibility for the child (raises the grade)
